journey.title: Started University
journey.desc: Walked in knowing how to open a terminal and not much else. Left knowing considerably more.

journey.title: First 'Hello World'
journey.desc: Discovered web dev outside of class and got hooked immediately.

journey.title: Mandatory Public Speaking Course
journey.desc: A required elective that had nothing to do with code.
journey.funnyFallback: Too busy debugging semicolons to prepare slides. Still afraid of microphones.

journey.title: First Internship
journey.desc: Shipped my first real feature to real users, then immediately broke prod.

journey.title: Frontend Developer
journey.desc: Built dozens of marketing sites and dashboards, obsessed over pixel-perfect motion.

journey.title: M.Sc. in Software Engineering
journey.desc: Took on a Master's degree while working full-time — a lot of very tired weekends.

journey.title: Gym Membership
journey.desc: Signed up with big plans for a summer body.
journey.funnyFallback: Went twice, decided 'sitting is the new cardio', canceled by September.

journey.title: Full Stack Developer
journey.desc: Owned features end to end, introduced TypeScript and CI pipelines to the team — all while finishing the Master's degree above.

journey.title: Learning Guitar
journey.desc: Bought a guitar to 'finally learn an instrument'.
journey.funnyFallback: Mastered exactly one campfire chord progression. The guitar now mostly holds hoodies.

journey.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
journey.desc: Building AI-assisted products end to end — bolting computer vision pipelines onto real backends.
